test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate adverb.

He completed the task ______ than anyone expected.
solution:
The correct answer is '**faster**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"faster"** is the comparative degree of the adverb **"fast."**
 
• When comparing two actions or situations, and the word **"than"** is present in the sentence, the comparative form of the modifier must be used.
 
• For short, one-syllable adverbs like "fast," the comparative is formed by adding the suffix **"-er."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He completed the task **faster**__ than anyone expected."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "fast"** is the positive degree. It is used for simple descriptions without comparison (e.g., "He ran fast").
 
• **Option 3: "fastest"** is the superlative degree, used when comparing one person or thing to a group of three or more.
 
• **Option 4: "most fast"** is grammatically incorrect. Adverbs that take "-er" for comparison do not use "more" or "most."
